Has a range of 14. Debuff immune towers was not immune to this ability. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Clown''' was an enemy that appeared in the second act of the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. It had an average speed and a decent amount of health. If there were no towers in its range, it would speed up until it had one in its range. While it was moving on the path, it would occasionally throw a bomb at a tower. This bomb would apply a 200% [[Fatigue Debuff]] to it and other nearby towers for 8 seconds and deal 80 damage to units. ==Appearance== The '''Clown''' was a humanoid with a light green skin tone and wore a stereotypical carnival clown outfit. It had a yellow striped shirt with short white sleeves, red striped overalls with blue straps and red shoes with white markings. It also had a red nose, red clown-styled hair and a blue and white neck ruff. It walked on a large blue and red pattern ball. It held a dark purple bomb with a white question mark on it. The '''Clown''' had a death animation, where it would trip and fall onto the ball on its back, dropping its bomb in the process. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Pursuit]] are quite effective against this. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at boosting their firerate and range respectively. *The [[Commander]] can be useful at partially mitigating the '''Clown's''' [[Fatigue Debuff]]. *Keep in mind that the '''Clown''' is able to hit all towers, including cliff and flying towers. *You can try and place cheap towers, like the [[Golden Soldier]] or [[Commander]], away from the main path, so that the '''Clown''' does not debuff your attacking towers. **It is best to use a tower you already have in your loadout instead of bringing a tower specifically for this, as it would take up space for more important towers. ==Update History== *'''31 October 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]g **'''Clown''' added. *'''21 December 2023''' - [[v1.11.0]] **'''Clown''' removed. {{TheHauntedPast|[[Frankenstein (Lunar Overture)|Frankenstein]]|Wave 11|Clown|Wave 13|[[Demon (Lunar Overture)|Demon]]|Wave 15}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Clown}}
